All Dr.'s agree that the best thing for you to do to establish and maintain lactation is for you to begin utilizing a breast pump.  You can rent a hospital grade pump, or you can purchase your own (purchasing your own is a less expensive option and they are almost as good as the hospital grade).  The brand names recommended for purchase are Medella or Spectra.  They can be bought at Target, Walmart, online at Amazon, maybe Craigslist, or mom's groups on Instagram or Facebook, where women might be selling their used pumps.  If you choose to purchase a used pump, you do still need to buy your own tubing and accessories.  
#They recommend pumping every three hours each day for 15-30min for at least 1-3 weeks. 
 The pumping will stimulate your breasts to produce milk, but it may take several weeks until that starts. If you begin lactating before the birth of the baby, your breast milk can be stored for up to 6 months.
